reasoning: Base ratings: the Cavaliers are +2.7 and the Grizzlies -1.2 points per game against an average team; with home court that makes the Cavaliers 7.3 better here, total 235.
Rest, travel and availability barely move it.
There are psychological storylines, but history says they are worth little here.
Bottom line: Cavaliers by 7.4, 70% to win; total 235 (80% range 211-259).
